interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance to the minimum necessary for operations and use high-visibility materials to signal pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, reducing exposure distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk and Signage
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with 'Pedestrian Crossing' warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or raised tables to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Curbing
interventions.description: Install curbs and define specific, narrower driveway entrances for the gas station to reduce the conflict zone and improve predictability of vehicle movements.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reconfigure the roadway to reduce the number of through lanes and narrow lane widths to slow traffic and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers at the intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Widening
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and add a landscaped buffer or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Enhanced Frontage Landscaping
interventions.description: Add low-level landscaping or a decorative fence between the sidewalk and the parking lot to improve the visual environment and clearly define the pedestrian realm.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the degraded pavement to improve safety and accessibility for all road users.
